completed_stage_receipts.summary: Classified the user-facing version namespace ambiguity as a real observability defect; the date/SVN idea is treated as a candidate mechanism, not automatic authority.
Requirement: one understandable revision in user receipts without replacing Git SHA, protocol version, controller revision or owner/task state version.
Mapped receipt display, persisted timestamps, manifest/owner version, Git identity, protocol compatibility, controller trace, cross-chat resume, cross-owner adoption and performance paths.
No prior accepted human-revision fix exists; root cause is namespace leakage, not missing source-control functionality. Treat as first-observed presentation/control-plane issue.

Studied SVN monotonic global revisions, Git tags/describe and CalVer. Accepted only the human-readable monotonic-revision and calendar-context ideas; rejected emulating SVN global counters across Git repositories.
Reuse existing authoritative updated_at + monotonic manifest/owner version. No counter service, registry, tag stream or Git-history traversal needed.

Rejected daily counter, tag-every-commit and SHA-only display. Accepted derived <scope>-YYYYMMDD-rN. Falsification checks cover same-day commits, midnight/date change, invalid scope/version, no history scan and namespace separation.
All design facts are retrievable; no new user decision required. Human revision is presentation-only and cannot become a second authority.
Existing progress/version authorities own the feature. No account instruction, new root policy, protocol bump or ENTRYPOINT growth required.
O(1) derivation from already-loaded metadata; one small deterministic helper and one focused test file. No new network call, counter, preload, registry or cross-repo lock.
Do not add a revision registry or per-commit tags. Keep Git/manifest/protocol/controller namespaces as-is and add only a derived display overlay.

Implemented Universal pilot format UC-YYYYMMDD-rN using persisted date + existing manifest_version. Receipt semantics now specify COMMITTED/NO_MATERIAL_CHANGE/COMMIT_FAILED/STALE_WRITER behavior. No stored duplicate revision field was added.
